newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua inflation 1.08 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua inflation 1.08 pct in September.

text.p: Nicaraguan inflation was 1.08 percent in September, fed by rising food prices, Nicaragua's Central Bank said on Monday.
Nicaragua's accumulated inflation as of September this year was 5.97 percent, slightly higher than the pace of inflation in 1995, which stood at an accumulated 5.21 percent at this time last year.
Accumulated inflation for the last 12 months was 11.54 percent.
The monthly cost of basic goods -- food, clothing and household products for a family of six -- rose by 15.11 cordobas ($1.74) in September for a total of 1,249.03 cordobas ($143.57).
